Class IAuraBackend

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Aura
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

The main graphics backend interface. Manages the GPU device, resource creation, pipeline state, and rendering commands. Analogous to the combination of ID3D11Device and ID3D11DeviceContext in Direct3D 11. Create one via CreateBackend().

public class IAuraBackend : AuraResourcePointer, IDisposable

Captures a snapshot of the current pipeline state for later restoration.

public IPipelineSnapshot TakeSnapshot(bool ignoreRenderTargets = false, bool ignoreTextures_CB_UAV = false, bool ignoreVertexIndexBuffer = false, bool ignoreState = false)

Parameters

ignoreRenderTargets bool

When true, render target bindings are excluded from the snapshot.

ignoreTextures_CB_UAV bool

When true, texture, constant buffer, and UAV bindings are excluded from the snapshot.

ignoreVertexIndexBuffer bool

When true, vertex and index buffer bindings are excluded from the snapshot.

ignoreState bool

When true, pipeline state objects (blend, rasterizer, depth-stencil) are excluded from the snapshot.

Returns

IPipelineSnapshot

An IPipelineSnapshot holding the captured state.
